top.line: The website cell mapped: the unit, five designs, ownership with Claude, price, market, partners and channels.
top.para: Every cell a behaviour policy in action.

in-short.line: One unit set up automatically, five designs, yours with your Claude, £500 anchor, partners 50/50.

why.line: Everyone shown a site asks for one; the factory is automated; so what is the unit and who buys it.

unit.line: A configured repository, live site and address, HTTPS, CI, a CLAUDE.md, a behaviour policy, a vault copy.
unit.para: Hard by hand; minutes by the factory.

designs.line: A team of agents makes five designs from the person's photos, videos and words.
designs.para: Claude, and Claude Design, at their best.

yours.line: The owner changes it with their own Claude: Yiheng's CV PDF became her latest experience on the site.
yours.para: Guard rails; explorer and town planner.

price.line: £500 one-off anchor, a launch price to decide, no subscription; running it is nearly free.
price.para: Simulated buyers: who runs it after?

market.line: AI builders lock in at £9 to £30 a month; vibe-coding adds credits; freelancers charge £800 to £3,000.
market.para: Nobody hands over a repository with its own agent rules.

partners.line: Partners sell, we build, 50/50: outplacement, formation agents, portfolio platforms, chambers, freelancers.
partners.para: A website beside what they already sell.

where.line: Our own sites, Fiverr, Upwork, Contra, LinkedIn, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, Product Hunt, Show HN.

many.line: Every website cell is agents under a behaviour policy for a real person; many make a market.
many.para: Open source; most will not do it themselves.

limits.line: Nothing sold yet; others' prices from trackers; buyers simulated; partner terms a draft.

sources.line: agenticcells.ai and its team's strategy, market trackers and earlier articles.
